summary: Independent review of the updated Release Intelligence v2.0.0-GA GOLDEN BUILD ZIP SHA256 26dceab9cf3e2480737a8cfd908b73fd024ef10aedd80720a24bdb9d817f1ad5. All 28 packaged files byte-match source. Each selected grouping field is now a removable active-filter/history item, so single-Escape undo includes grouping; Clear and double Escape reset grouping state and selection together while existing menu/editor/popup priority remains. Slack reminder rendering tokenizes exact allowlisted GUS links and the matched mention before formatting escaped text, preserving ADM_Epic__c URLs instead of treating underscores inside hrefs as italics. Plain clipboard fallback preserves readable names and complete URLs. Existing recipient-binding guards and no-send behavior remain. Independently executed all 22 focused controls, grouping, nudge, and Slack-format tests successfully. No blocking issues found. Overall application risk remains High under the existing rubric assessment.
caveats: Clipboard HTML preserves exact links in the reviewed implementation, but actual Slack paste, automatic link conversion, and native mention recognition remain unverified. Users must inspect the recipient, links, and mention after pasting before manual sending.

Slack actions prepare/copy reminders and optionally open a verified workspace-qualified DM. They neither send messages nor prefill a Slack draft. Actual production identity resolution and deep-link navigation remain unverified.
Escape closes an open menu, editor, or preview first. Filter/group undo follows only after those transient controls are closed; single-Escape undo waits for the existing double-press window.

Existing bulk scope limits and fresh-read snapshots, strict heuristic AI grounding/fallback, chronological rich-text fail-closed behavior, usage completeness, preview caching/cancellation, refresh concurrency, journal growth, revision conflicts, non-atomic updates, preference semantics, host/catalog/history limits, and AllUsers sharing caveats remain.
Current GUS Apps host metadata still relies on verified-definition snapshots; automatic future list-column detection remains unavailable without live list-view REST capability.

This review combined static source/artifact inspection with 22 independently executed focused tests. The implementing agent reported all 166 Node tests and the bulk/Slack browser regression passed, including DOM-parsed clipboard URL/label assertions. The implementing agent subsequently reported the grouped/interleaved Escape regression passed, including reverse/interleaved undo, Clear, exactly one forced double-Escape refresh, transient-control priority, and mobile layout. Those full suites, production-host/model/Slack behavior, remote publication, and golden-tag movement were not independently verified.
